learning_objective: The learner can explain how adapter-based finetuning works by inserting trainable adapter modules into transformer layers while keeping original model parameters frozen, and identify its trade-offs in parameter efficiency versus inference latency.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing adapter-based finetuning updates all model weights when it actually keeps original parameters unchanged and only updates adapter parameters.
Assuming adapter-based finetuning has no inference overhead when it actually increases inference latency due to the inserted adapter modules.
Thinking adapter-based finetuning needs the same memory as full finetuning when it uses far fewer trainable parameters and can run on mid-tier GPUs.
